configure.title: Inkomba yesinyathelo
configure.description: Bonisa izinyathelo njengomugqa omncane wezihloko okhombisa inqubekelaphambili. Okuqukethwe kwesinyathelo akuboniswa kulesi sakhiwo.

configure.title: Isinyathelo samanje
configure.description: Isinyathelo umfundi akuso, kubalwa kusuka ku-1. Izinyathelo zangaphambili ziboniswa njengeziqediwe. Kusetshenziswa yinkomba yesinyathelo.
